name: Case File
tagline: A launch told as an investigation: typed case notes, redaction bars, red string on a corkboard and a stamp that closes the case.
description: Detective-dossier style for product launches and problem/solution stories. Grey-green paper with grain and vignette, typewriter case notes whose key facts get wiped out by black redaction bars, index-card tickets pinned to a dark corkboard and joined by red string that draws on, one huge serif number, a rubber stamp with ink texture that slams onto the file, then a clean resolved product card. Captions type out in a small dark bar at the bottom.

display.usage: The huge evidence number (≈500px) and the final wordmark (170px)

body.usage: Ticket headings, the rubber stamp (900, 110px, 12px border) and the resolved product card

mono.usage: Typed case notes 40px, card labels 15–22px tracked 0.24em, captions 32px bold in the dark bar

transitions: hard cuts between beats (typed sheet, corkboard, big number, stamp, clean reveal)
slow 2–6% push on every evidence shot
stamp impact shakes the paper for 0.2s
textAnimations: captions type out character by character (≈0.025s per char) in a dark bar
black redaction bars wipe left→right over key facts, 0.24s each, 0.17s apart
the big number counts 0→N with power2.out while scaling down from 1.12
stamp drops from scale 2.4 at -9° with power4.in in 0.2s

rhythm.notes: Five beats: the file, the board, the number, the stamp, the fix. One typed caption per beat; let the stamp land just after the caption starts.

guide:
- Look only: build the user's own subject in this visual language; don't reuse the example's scene.
- Ground is grey-green paper (#c4c7b0 → #8f937c radial) with a multiply feTurbulence grain and soft vignette; darker scenes sit on cork #2a2820. Ink #161712, sheets #e2e0cd, cards #e6e3d2. No pure white until the final clean reveal (#fbfbf7).
- Story text is typed: Courier Prime 40px on a #e2e0cd sheet under a tracked uppercase header (15–22px, 0.24em) and a rule. Black #121310 redaction bars wipe over key words (scaleX 0→1, power3.inOut, 0.24s, 0.17s stagger) only after the line is readable.
- Present the subject as evidence: photos, sketches or facts on index cards (-4° to 3° rotations, heavy drop shadow) that drop in with back.out(1.6), held by glossy red pins and joined by 3px #c2241f strings with a slight sag that draw on (power2.inOut).
- Optional motif: one huge Playfair Display 900 number (≈500px) that counts up with power2.out while scaling down from 1.12, circled by a hand-drawn red loop.
- Optional motif: a rubber stamp in Inter 900 uppercase (~110px) inside a 12px rounded border, green #2f7d4a (red for open or unsolved), rotated about -9°, inked with an feTurbulence alpha mask plus displacement. It slams from scale 2.4 with power4.in in 0.2s and shakes the paper for 0.2s.
- Every beat gets one caption typed at ~0.025s per character in Courier Prime 700, 32px, inside a #17180f bar centred near y≈950.
- Hard cuts between beats of ~1.6s, with a slow 2–6% push on every shot. Resolve on something clean on #fbfbf7 and a Playfair Display 900 wordmark (170px).
- Avoid glossy UI, gradients, bright colours beyond string red and stamp green, mascots and real brand logos.
example: The preview tells a docs-tool launch as a case: typed notes about an outdated help article with redacted facts, support tickets on a corkboard linked by red string, a counting ticket number, a 'CASE CLOSED' stamp and a clean help page. Don't copy this scene unless asked.
